## Data {#sec-data}

```{python}
#| label: setup
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

months = list(range(1, 13))
sales = [12, 14, 13, 17, 19, 22, 21, 24, 23, 27, 29, 31]
```

## Results {#sec-results}

```{python}
#| label: fig-trend
#| fig-cap: "Monthly sales."
#| fig-alt: "Line chart of sales rising from 12 in January to 31 in December."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))
ax.plot(months, sales, marker="o")
ax.set_xlabel("Month")
ax.set_ylabel("Sales")
plt.show()
```
